attributed to [孫思邈](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AD%AB%E6%80%9D%E9%82%88) (Sūn Sīmiǎo, c. 581–682)

One of Sūn Sīmiǎo's attributed Daoist-medical trilogy alongside [KR5c0231](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0231) and [KR5c0232](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0232).

**Dating.** Traditional Sūn Sīmiǎo dates. Dynasty: 隋-唐.
